_about: Extra metadata stamped on every chunk of a PDF at ingestion (app/database.py: apply_document_metadata). Chroma metadata must be scalar: strings, numbers or booleans. 'defaults_by_category' is keyed by the data/ folder name ('faq', '2024', ...; '*' = any other folder). 'files' is keyed by PDF file name and overrides the defaults. Re-ingest with `python -m app.database --reset` after editing so existing chunks pick up the change.

fields.tax_year: the tax year a rule document applies to ('' = not year-specific)
fields.computation_related: true when the document explains how a tax is computed
fields.rule_ids: comma-separated tax_rules/*.json rule_id values this document supports
